crossRefs.note: Be it known to you therefore, brothers, that through this man is proclaimed to you remission of sins,
It shall happen, that whoever will not listen to my words which he shall speak in my name, I will require it of him.
He who believes and is baptized will be saved; but he who disbelieves will be condemned.
He who believes in him is not judged. He who doesn’t believe has been judged already, because he has not believed in…
I said therefore to you that you will die in your sins; for unless you believe that I am he, you will die in your sins.”
He who rejects me, and doesn’t receive my sayings, has one who judges him. The word that I spoke will judge him in the…
and to give relief to you who are afflicted with us, when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with his mighty angels…
how will we escape if we neglect so great a salvation—which at the first having been spoken through the Lord, was…
A man who disregards Moses’ law dies without compassion on the word of two or three witnesses.
But we are not of those who shrink back to destruction, but of those who have faith to the saving of the soul.
See that you don’t refuse him who speaks. For if they didn’t escape when they refused him who warned on the earth, how…
All who dwell on the earth will worship him, everyone whose name has not been written from the foundation of the world…
If anyone was not found written in the book of life, he was cast into the lake of fire.

translations.web: It will be that every soul that will not listen to that prophet will be utterly destroyed from among the people.’
translations.bsb: Everyone who does not listen to Him will be completely cut off from among his people.’
translations.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that every soul, which will not hear that prophet, shall be destroyed from among the people.
translations.asv: And it shall be, that every soul that shall not hearken to that prophet, shall be utterly destroyed from among the people.
